# Browser plugin wire protocol

What an extension and the browser plugin say to each other once paired: every
route on the plugin's listener, the events on its stream, and the shape of
each body. How an extension pairs in the first place is in the README.

`WIRE_VERSION`: `d9142fc645c80eba`. The ticket request carries it, and a mismatch is
refused (409): the plugin decodes strictly, so any change to a route, field
or type is a breaking one, and changes the version. A doc edit does not.

## Authentication

Every route takes the pairing token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`,
except the event stream, which takes a one-time ticket in its query
(`EventSource` cannot send headers): buy one with `POST /events/ticket`,
then open `GET /events?ticket=…&conn_id=…`. Bodies are JSON; unknown
fields are refused.

## Routes

| Method | Path | Request | Reply | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| PUT | `/grammar/frame` | `GrammarFrameRequest` | `GrammarFrameResponse` | A frame's whole grammar; replaces the last one for that frame. |
| POST | `/hints/session_end` | `HintsSessionEndRequest` | `Ack` | A tab's or a frame's hint session ended. |
| POST | `/hints/session_start` | `Empty` | `Ack` | A hints-eligible tab activated: make sure the hint-command skeleton is registered. |
| POST | `/range-pick` | `RangePickRequest` | `Ack` | Arm or release the disambiguation chip window. |
| POST | `/dispatch-result` | `DispatchResult` | `Ack` | The outcome of one dispatched action. |
| POST | `/surgery/result` | `SurgeryResult` | `Ack` | The reply to one tab-surgery request. |
| PUT | `/session` | `SessionRequest` | `Ack` | This connection's whole mode state (caret, find, video, keep-scrolling, query field, media); replaces the last. |
| POST | `/focus` | `FocusRequest` | `Ack` | A focus claim. |
| POST | `/active-tab` | `ActiveTabRequest` | `Ack` | The active tab of this browser's window. |
| POST | `/tabs` | `TabsRequest` | `Ack` | This connection's open-tab words. |
| POST | `/palette` | `PaletteRequest` | `Ack` | Open or close the palette's voice session. |
| POST | `/commands/contribute` | `ContributeRequest` | `Ack` | Replace this connection's contributed command catalog. |
| POST | `/commands/override` | `PhraseEdit` | `Ack` | Set a command-phrase override (refusal text is the platform's validation). |
| POST | `/commands/override/reset` | `OverrideResetRequest` | `Ack` | Revert a command-phrase override. |
| GET | `/commands/overrides` | `Empty` (query) | `OverridesResponse` | This plugin's phrase overrides. |
| POST | `/commands/alias` | `PhraseEdit` | `Ack` | Add a spoken form. |
| POST | `/commands/alias/remove` | `PhraseEdit` | `Ack` | Remove an added spoken form. |
| GET | `/commands/aliases` | `Empty` (query) | `AliasesResponse` | This plugin's added spoken forms. |
| POST | `/settings/hint_display` | `SetHintDisplayRequest` | `Ack` | The popup's badge-label pick. |
| POST | `/references` | `ReferenceNamesRequest` | `Ack` | The saved reference names voice can match. |
| GET | `/references` | `ReferencesQuery` (query) | `ReferencesResponse` | One host's stored references (reinstall recovery). |
| POST | `/reference/save` | `ReferenceSaveRequest` | `Ack` | Save one reference. |
| PUT | `/settings-backup` | `SettingsBackupPutRequest` | `Ack` | Keep this browser's copy of the extension's settings (413 past 1 MB; 409 for an empty copy over a non-empty one without force). |
| GET | `/settings-backup` | `SettingsBackupQuery` (query) | `SettingsBackupResponse` | The kept copy of the extension's settings: this family's, else the newest. |
| POST | `/debug-log` | `DebugLogRequest` | `Ack` | A diagnostic line for branchkit.log. |
| POST | `/plugin-debug-log` | `PluginDebugLogRequest` | `Ack` | A diagnostic line for this plugin's log. |
| POST | `/perf-report` | `PerfReportRequest` | `Ack` | A perf snapshot for the JSONL trail. |
| POST | `/debug-snapshot` | `DebugSnapshot` | `Ack` | The structured half of a diagnostics snapshot. |
| POST | `/debug-snapshot/screenshot` | `DebugScreenshotRequest` | `Ack` | The snapshot's viewport PNG, or why there is none. |
| GET | `/debug/matchable` | `Empty` (query) | `MatchableView` | This plugin's active gates and eligible commands, as the platform holds them (the snapshot's reconcile). |
| POST | `/events/ticket` | `TicketRequest` | `TicketResponse` | A one-time ticket for the event stream; refused (409) on a wire_version mismatch. |
| GET | `/events` | `EventsQuery` (query) | event stream | The event stream (SSE): connected, alphabet, action. |
| GET | `/health` | `Empty` (query) | `HealthResponse` | Liveness and stream-client count, for debugging (served without CORS headers). |

## Stream events

The event stream (SSE): connected, alphabet, action. Each named SSE event's data is JSON:

| Event | Data |
|---|---|
| `connected` | `ConnectedEvent` |
| `alphabet` | `AlphabetEvent` |
| `action` | `ActionEvent` |

## Actions the plugin mints

An `action` event is either a command the extension contributed (its own
action name, with the params the platform matched) or one of these:

| Action | Params |
|---|---|
| `reactivate` | `ReactivateParams` |
| `noop` | `NoopParams` |
| `set_badge_mode` | `SetBadgeModeParams` |
| `palette_assign` | `PaletteAssignParams` |
| `select_exit` | `ModeExitParams` |
| `palette_dismiss` | `ModeExitParams` |
| `video_exit` | `ModeExitParams` |
| `auto_scroll_stop` | `ModeExitParams` |
| `query_windows` | `QueryWindowsParams` |
| `move_active_tab_to_window` | `MoveActiveTabToWindowParams` |
| `pop_active_tab` | `PopActiveTabParams` |
| `resize_window` | `ResizeWindowParams` |

As TypeScript, with each type's and field's documentation (the same file the
BranchKit extension builds against):

```ts
/* eslint-disable */
// The extension <-> browser plugin protocol. Source: the Go package
// plugins/browser/src/wire (types.go, events.go, routes.go).

/** When hint badges show: always, or on demand. */
export type HintVisibility = 'always' | 'manual';

/**
 * Ack is the reply of every write route that returns no data: ok, or not ok
 * with the reason. A refused request answers it with a 4xx/5xx status.
 */
export interface Ack {
  ok: boolean;
  error?: string;
}

/**
 * ActionEvent is one action for the extension. Params is a JSON object: the
 * typed params of a synthetic action (SyntheticActions), or, for a
 * contributed command, the params the platform matched — strings, except
 * `targets`, the ordered list of a multi-target verb.
 */
export interface ActionEvent {
  action: string;
  params?: Record<string, unknown>;
  /** The inbound on_action's tr_ id; empty for synthetic events. */
  correlation_id?: string;
}

/**
 * ActiveTabRequest reports the active tab of this browser's window. No focus
 * claim; only the focused connection's report moves the focused tab.
 */
export interface ActiveTabRequest {
  conn_id: string;
  tab_id: number;
  hint_visibility: HintVisibility;
}

/** AliasesResponse lists this plugin's added spoken forms. */
export interface AliasesResponse {
  aliases: PhraseEdit[] | null;
}

/** AlphabetEvent carries the 26 voice codewords, letter order. */
export interface AlphabetEvent {
  words: string[] | null;
}

/** ConnectedEvent opens every stream. */
export interface ConnectedEvent {
  /** The plugin's WIRE_VERSION, the same one the ticket checked. */
  wire_version: string;
}

/** ContributeRequest replaces this connection's contributed catalog. */
export interface ContributeRequest {
  conn_id: string;
  commands: ContributedCommand[] | null;
}

/**
 * ContributedCommand is one command of the extension's static vocabulary.
 * Action is a bare id; the plugin prefixes it and owns the context gate.
 */
export interface ContributedCommand {
  action: string;
  pattern: string;
  params?: Record<string, string>;
  category?: string;
  description?: string;
  /**
   * For {hint} patterns: the verb leaves hints painted and live, so the
   * plugin must not clear the hints tag.
   */
  retains_hints?: boolean;
  /**
   * Voice-context gate: "palette", "caret", "video", "auto_scroll", "find";
   * empty = app-active.
   */
  context?: string;
  /**
   * Prefix-discovery affordance ("prefix" | "exclusive"), passed through to
   * the platform, which validates it.
   */
  discovery?: string;
}

/** DebugLogRequest relays a diagnostic line into branchkit.log. */
export interface DebugLogRequest {
  /** Required; prefixed verbatim so lines stay greppable. */
  tag: string;
  data?: unknown;
}

/**
 * DebugScreenshotRequest attaches the viewport PNG, or the capture error, to
 * a snapshot. Exactly one of png_base64 / error.
 */
export interface DebugScreenshotRequest {
  snapshot_id: string;
  png_base64?: string;
  error?: string;
}

/**
 * DebugSnapshot is the structured half of a hint-diagnostics snapshot. Any
 * JSON object; snapshot_id is required (and checked for filesystem safety).
 */
export type DebugSnapshot = { snapshot_id: string; [key: string]: unknown };

/**
 * DispatchResult is the outcome of one extension-side action attempt, posted
 * after every dispatched action so the log traces voice to outcome.
 */
export interface DispatchResult {
  /** "activate", "scroll", "noop", ... */
  action: string;
  /**
   * The codeword ("arch check"); empty for non-codeword actions;
   * resolve_reference carries the reference name.
   */
  codeword: string;
  /**
   * How the target resolved. range_pick = a disambiguation chip,
   * search_badge = a search-match jump, extra_hint = something that only
   * looked clickable, reference = a saved reference.
   */
  resolution: 'snapshot' | 'live_store' | 'range_pick' | 'search_badge' | 'extra_hint' | 'reference' | 'none';
  /** Tag of the resolved element ("input", "a"). */
  elem_tag: string;
  taken: 'focus' | 'click' | 'skipped' | 'noop';
  ok: boolean;
  /** The frame's location, trimmed. */
  frame: string;
  /** An error or note; some values are refusal codes (problem.go refusalFor). */
  detail: string;
  /**
   * Work the page cannot finish and the platform can: open_select = press
   * the key that opens the native list of the <select> just focused.
   */
  followup?: 'open_select';
  /** The posting connection: a follow-up acts only when it is in front. */
  conn_id: string;
  /** With detail "no_such_hint" only: the hint exists but cannot be seen. */
  unseen?: 'off_screen' | 'not_visible' | 'disabled';
}

/**
 * Empty is a request with no fields: a POST with an empty object, or a GET
 * with no query parameters.
 */
export type Empty = Record<string, never>;

/**
 * EventsQuery opens the event stream. EventSource cannot send headers, hence
 * the query.
 */
export interface EventsQuery {
  ticket: string;
  conn_id: string;
}

/**
 * FocusRequest is a focus claim: a window of this connection's browser gained
 * (or lost) OS focus.
 */
export interface FocusRequest {
  conn_id: string;
  focused: boolean;
  /** The OS-focused window; 0 when none. */
  window_id: number;
  hint_visibility: HintVisibility;
  /**
   * Per connection, increasing in the order focus changed; a claim not newer
   * than the last applied one is dropped.
   */
  seq?: number;
  /** Epoch ms of the change; orders claims across connections. */
  claimed_at?: number;
}

/**
 * GrammarElement is one codeword a frame holds: only what the plugin consumes.
 * Its frame is the request's; the element's label, category and adapter stay
 * in the extension.
 */
export interface GrammarElement {
  /** Registry id minted by the content script; 0 = not addressable. */
  id: number;
  /** The scanner's element type ("link", "button", "record_action", ...). */
  type: string;
  /** The two-word spoken codeword ("arch bake"). */
  codeword: string;
  /**
   * The element intersects the strict viewport at send time: only these
   * enter the `_strict` companion collection (the Discovery HUD and the
   * activate command's capture). Band-only entries are painted, not matchable.
   */
  in_strict_viewport?: boolean;
}

/** GrammarFailure says why one element was not stored. */
export interface GrammarFailure {
  codeword: string;
  reason: string;
}

/**
 * GrammarFrameRequest is a frame's whole grammar: every codeword it holds right
 * now. It replaces whatever the plugin held for that frame, so there are no
 * deltas to lose, no ordering between requests to keep, and nothing to rebuild
 * after either side restarts — the next request is complete by itself.
 */
export interface GrammarFrameRequest {
  /** Stamped by the service worker from the message sender. */
  tab_id: number;
  /** Stamped by the service worker from the message sender. */
  frame_id: number;
  /**
   * chrome.windows id of the sending tab, stamped by the service worker.
   * Tells the OS-focused window from a side-by-side window of the same
   * browser; 0 = unknown (the gate fails open on window).
   */
  window_id: number;
  /**
   * The sending frame is foreground (document.visibilityState === 'visible').
   * A background tab reports false and is stored, never projected.
   */
  visible: boolean;
  /**
   * The sending content script's document identity, stable for the
   * document's life. A frame-scoped session_end is fenced against it.
   */
  doc_id: string;
  /** The extension's connection nonce, stamped by the service worker. */
  conn_id: string;
  hint_visibility: HintVisibility;
  elements: GrammarElement[] | null;
}

/** GrammarFrameResponse acknowledges a frame's grammar. */
export interface GrammarFrameResponse {
  /**
   * "ok" = stored and projected; "stored" = stored, not projected (the
   * source is not the focused one); "calibration_active" = refused during
   * a calibration trial (nothing stored; send again later).
   */
  result: 'ok' | 'stored' | 'calibration_active';
  failed: GrammarFailure[] | null;
  /** The frame's codeword count after this request (a log breadcrumb). */
  committed_codewords: number;
}

/**
 * HealthResponse is for a person or agent debugging: the extension never
 * calls it.
 */
export interface HealthResponse {
  ready: boolean;
  stream_clients: number;
}

/**
 * HintsSessionEndRequest ends a hint session: a whole tab (frame_id absent) or
 * one frame (frame_id and doc_id).
 */
export interface HintsSessionEndRequest {
  conn_id: string;
  reason: string;
  tab_id: number;
  /** Absent = the whole tab. A pointer because 0 is the top frame. */
  frame_id?: number;
  /**
   * The document this frame-scoped end is about; a session holding another
   * document's batches is left alone (a navigation's late disconnect).
   */
  doc_id?: string;
}

/** MatchableCommand is one eligible command, by the tags it requires. */
export interface MatchableCommand {
  requires_tags: string[] | null;
}

/**
 * MatchableView is the platform's matcher state as it bears on this plugin's
 * commands: which of this plugin's gates the platform holds active, and which
 * of its commands those gates make eligible. Read for a diagnostics
 * snapshot's painted-versus-matchable reconcile. Exclusive modes of other
 * plugins are not visible here, so a command listed eligible can still be
 * suppressed by one.
 */
export interface MatchableView {
  active_tags: string[] | null;
  eligible: MatchableCommand[] | null;
}

/**
 * ModeExitParams ends an extension mode whose tag something else cleared
 * (select_exit, palette_dismiss, video_exit, auto_scroll_stop).
 */
export interface ModeExitParams {
  action: string;
}

/** MoveActiveTabToWindowParams moves the active tab into a window. */
export interface MoveActiveTabToWindowParams {
  request_id: string;
  window_id: number;
  activate: boolean;
}

/** NoopParams un-narrows the display, or narrows it to a spoken prefix. */
export interface NoopParams {
  prefix?: string;
}

/** OverrideResetRequest reverts one override to the default phrase. */
export interface OverrideResetRequest {
  action: string;
  default_pattern: string;
}

/** OverridesResponse lists this plugin's phrase overrides. */
export interface OverridesResponse {
  overrides: PhraseEdit[] | null;
}

/**
 * PaletteAssignParams carries the platform's codeword assignments for the
 * open palette: row_id -> spoken codeword.
 */
export interface PaletteAssignParams {
  assignments: Record<string, string> | null;
}

/**
 * PaletteEntry is one palette row. Spoken present = a pinned codeword (the
 * tabs scope's marks); absent = the platform assigns. RowID is the
 * extension's opaque handle; Title and Group are display-only.
 */
export interface PaletteEntry {
  spoken?: string;
  title: string;
  group: string;
  row_id: string;
}

/**
 * PaletteRequest opens (entries) or closes (no entries) the palette's voice
 * session.
 */
export interface PaletteRequest {
  conn_id: string;
  entries: PaletteEntry[] | null;
  reserves?: string[];
}

/**
 * PerfReportRequest is one content-script perf snapshot, appended to a JSONL
 * trail for offline analysis.
 */
export interface PerfReportRequest {
  url: string;
  tab_id: number;
  browser: string;
  snapshot: unknown;
}

/**
 * PhraseEdit is a command-phrase override or alias in the extension's
 * notation: a bare action id and {..} captures.
 */
export interface PhraseEdit {
  action: string;
  default_pattern: string;
  new_pattern: string;
}

/** PluginDebugLogRequest relays a diagnostic line into this plugin's own log. */
export interface PluginDebugLogRequest {
  tag: string;
  data?: unknown;
  /** trace / debug / info / warn / error; empty or unknown = debug. */
  level?: string;
}

/**
 * PopActiveTabParams moves the active tab into a new window, at these bounds
 * when given.
 */
export interface PopActiveTabParams {
  request_id: string;
  left?: number;
  top?: number;
  width?: number;
  height?: number;
}

/** QueryWindowsParams asks for this browser's normal windows with bounds. */
export interface QueryWindowsParams {
  request_id: string;
}

/**
 * RangePickRequest arms (codewords) or releases (empty) the disambiguation
 * chip window: while armed the hint projection narrows to the chips.
 */
export interface RangePickRequest {
  conn_id: string;
  tab_id: number;
  codewords: string[] | null;
}

/**
 * ReactivateParams asks the extension to rebuild and re-push its grammar (a
 * fresh stream, or a refocus that found the plugin's state for the tab gone).
 */
export interface ReactivateParams {
  reason: string;
  /** "active" = the active tab only. */
  target?: 'active';
}

/**
 * ReferenceNamesRequest replaces the set of saved reference names voice can
 * match.
 */
export interface ReferenceNamesRequest {
  names: string[] | null;
}

/** ReferenceSaveRequest saves one reference to the durable collection. */
export interface ReferenceSaveRequest {
  host: string;
  name: string;
  reference: Record<string, unknown> | null;
}

/** ReferencesQuery asks for one host's stored references. */
export interface ReferencesQuery {
  host: string;
}

/** ReferencesResponse is one host's stored references, by name. */
export interface ReferencesResponse {
  references: Record<string, unknown> | null;
}

/** ResizeWindowParams sets a window's width (the reverse identity probe). */
export interface ResizeWindowParams {
  request_id: string;
  window_id: number;
  width: number;
}

/**
 * SessionModes are the extension's mirrored modes, each a level: true while
 * the mode is on in some live frame of this browser.
 */
export interface SessionModes {
  /** Caret/visual selection (exclusive caret tag). */
  caret: boolean;
  /** A find session: bar open or committed highlights (non-exclusive). */
  find: boolean;
  /** The video key layer (exclusive video_mode tag). */
  video: boolean;
  /** A keep-scrolling run (exclusive auto_scroll tag). */
  auto_scroll: boolean;
}

/**
 * SessionRequest is a connection's whole mode state. Every PUT replaces the
 * last, so a dropped or reordered request is healed by the next one and a
 * reconnect replays one request instead of an edge per mode. A mode turned on
 * takes its tag only from the focused connection (or with focus unknown,
 * except the query field); turned off, it releases the tag only if this
 * connection holds it.
 */
export interface SessionRequest {
  conn_id: string;
  modes: SessionModes;
  /** Focus is in a single-line text input: dictation there is a query. */
  query_field: boolean;
  /**
   * This browser has something media-controllable (focused-tab video,
   * an audible tab, or the resume memory).
   */
  media_active: boolean;
}

/** SetBadgeModeParams carries the settings collection's hint_display. */
export interface SetBadgeModeParams {
  mode: 'word' | 'letter' | 'expand';
}

/**
 * SetHintDisplayRequest relays the popup's badge-label pick into the settings
 * collection, the setting's one owner.
 */
export interface SetHintDisplayRequest {
  hint_display: 'word' | 'letter' | 'expand';
}

/**
 * SettingsBackupPutRequest stores this browser's copy of the extension's
 * durable settings, replacing the copy kept for its browser family. The
 * document is the extension's own backup file format; the plugin keeps it
 * as given and reads only whether its settings are empty.
 */
export interface SettingsBackupPutRequest {
  conn_id: string;
  browser: 'chrome' | 'firefox';
  /**
   * The backup document: {schemaVersion, exportedAt, extensionVersion,
   * browser, settings: {sync, local}}.
   */
  backup: unknown;
  /**
   * Replace a copy that has settings with one that has none. Without it
   * that write is refused (409): a fresh install must not overwrite the
   * good copy before the user has chosen to restore it or start fresh.
   */
  force?: boolean;
}

/** SettingsBackupQuery asks for the kept copy of the extension's settings. */
export interface SettingsBackupQuery {
  /** Prefer this browser family's copy; without one, the newest of any. */
  browser?: 'chrome' | 'firefox';
}

/** SettingsBackupResponse is the kept copy, or found:false when there is none. */
export interface SettingsBackupResponse {
  found: boolean;
  /** The browser family the copy came from. */
  browser?: string;
  /** When the plugin stored it, epoch ms. */
  saved_at?: number;
  /** The document as the extension sent it. */
  backup?: unknown;
}

/**
 * SurgeryResult answers one tab-surgery request (query_windows,
 * move_active_tab_to_window, pop_active_tab, resize_window), routed to the
 * waiter by request_id.
 */
export interface SurgeryResult {
  request_id: string;
  ok: boolean;
  error?: string;
  /** pop_active_tab: the window it created. */
  window?: WindowInfo;
  /** query_windows: the full inventory. */
  windows?: WindowInfo[];
}

/**
 * TabEntry is one spoken word for an open tab. TabID is a string because it
 * becomes the value the matcher substitutes into action params.
 */
export interface TabEntry {
  spoken: string;
  tab_id: string;
}

/** TabsRequest publishes this connection's open-tab words. */
export interface TabsRequest {
  conn_id: string;
  entries: TabEntry[] | null;
}

/**
 * TicketRequest buys a one-time ticket for the event stream. The pairing
 * token travels in the header; only the ticket goes in the stream URL.
 */
export interface TicketRequest {
  /**
   * The extension's WIRE_VERSION. A mismatch is refused (409): the two
   * sides were built from different protocol declarations.
   */
  wire_version: string;
}

/**
 * TicketResponse carries the ticket, or the refusal. wire_version is always
 * the plugin's, so a refused extension can say which side is out of date.
 */
export interface TicketResponse {
  ok: boolean;
  ticket?: string;
  error?: 'wire_version_mismatch' | string;
  wire_version: string;
}

/**
 * WindowInfo is one browser window as the extension reports it for tab
 * surgery.
 */
export interface WindowInfo {
  window_id: number;
  left: number;
  top: number;
  width: number;
  height: number;
  state: string;
  active_tab_title: string;
  /** The window holding the active tab — the tab any surgery would move. */
  is_source: boolean;
}

/** The POST routes: path -> request body and reply. */
export interface PostRoutes {
  /** A tab's or a frame's hint session ended. */
  '/hints/session_end': { req: HintsSessionEndRequest; resp: Ack };
  /** A hints-eligible tab activated: make sure the hint-command skeleton is registered. */
  '/hints/session_start': { req: Empty; resp: Ack };
  /** Arm or release the disambiguation chip window. */
  '/range-pick': { req: RangePickRequest; resp: Ack };
  /** The outcome of one dispatched action. */
  '/dispatch-result': { req: DispatchResult; resp: Ack };
  /** The reply to one tab-surgery request. */
  '/surgery/result': { req: SurgeryResult; resp: Ack };
  /** A focus claim. */
  '/focus': { req: FocusRequest; resp: Ack };
  /** The active tab of this browser's window. */
  '/active-tab': { req: ActiveTabRequest; resp: Ack };
  /** This connection's open-tab words. */
  '/tabs': { req: TabsRequest; resp: Ack };
  /** Open or close the palette's voice session. */
  '/palette': { req: PaletteRequest; resp: Ack };
  /** Replace this connection's contributed command catalog. */
  '/commands/contribute': { req: ContributeRequest; resp: Ack };
  /** Set a command-phrase override (refusal text is the platform's validation). */
  '/commands/override': { req: PhraseEdit; resp: Ack };
  /** Revert a command-phrase override. */
  '/commands/override/reset': { req: OverrideResetRequest; resp: Ack };
  /** Add a spoken form. */
  '/commands/alias': { req: PhraseEdit; resp: Ack };
  /** Remove an added spoken form. */
  '/commands/alias/remove': { req: PhraseEdit; resp: Ack };
  /** The popup's badge-label pick. */
  '/settings/hint_display': { req: SetHintDisplayRequest; resp: Ack };
  /** The saved reference names voice can match. */
  '/references': { req: ReferenceNamesRequest; resp: Ack };
  /** Save one reference. */
  '/reference/save': { req: ReferenceSaveRequest; resp: Ack };
  /** A diagnostic line for branchkit.log. */
  '/debug-log': { req: DebugLogRequest; resp: Ack };
  /** A diagnostic line for this plugin's log. */
  '/plugin-debug-log': { req: PluginDebugLogRequest; resp: Ack };
  /** A perf snapshot for the JSONL trail. */
  '/perf-report': { req: PerfReportRequest; resp: Ack };
  /** The structured half of a diagnostics snapshot. */
  '/debug-snapshot': { req: DebugSnapshot; resp: Ack };
  /** The snapshot's viewport PNG, or why there is none. */
  '/debug-snapshot/screenshot': { req: DebugScreenshotRequest; resp: Ack };
  /** A one-time ticket for the event stream; refused (409) on a wire_version mismatch. */
  '/events/ticket': { req: TicketRequest; resp: TicketResponse };
}

/** The PUT routes: path -> request body (the whole state it replaces) and reply. */
export interface PutRoutes {
  /** A frame's whole grammar; replaces the last one for that frame. */
  '/grammar/frame': { req: GrammarFrameRequest; resp: GrammarFrameResponse };
  /** This connection's whole mode state (caret, find, video, keep-scrolling, query field, media); replaces the last. */
  '/session': { req: SessionRequest; resp: Ack };
  /** Keep this browser's copy of the extension's settings (413 past 1 MB; 409 for an empty copy over a non-empty one without force). */
  '/settings-backup': { req: SettingsBackupPutRequest; resp: Ack };
}

/** The GET routes: path -> query parameters and reply (the event stream is EVENTS_PATH). */
export interface GetRoutes {
  /** This plugin's phrase overrides. */
  '/commands/overrides': { query: Empty; resp: OverridesResponse };
  /** This plugin's added spoken forms. */
  '/commands/aliases': { query: Empty; resp: AliasesResponse };
  /** One host's stored references (reinstall recovery). */
  '/references': { query: ReferencesQuery; resp: ReferencesResponse };
  /** The kept copy of the extension's settings: this family's, else the newest. */
  '/settings-backup': { query: SettingsBackupQuery; resp: SettingsBackupResponse };
  /** This plugin's active gates and eligible commands, as the platform holds them (the snapshot's reconcile). */
  '/debug/matchable': { query: Empty; resp: MatchableView };
  /** Liveness and stream-client count, for debugging (served without CORS headers). */
  '/health': { query: Empty; resp: HealthResponse };
}

export type PostPath = keyof PostRoutes;
export type PutPath = keyof PutRoutes;
export type GetPath = keyof GetRoutes;

/** The event stream (SSE): connected, alphabet, action. Query: EventsQuery. */
export const EVENTS_PATH = '/events';

/** The named SSE events and their data. */
export interface StreamEvents {
  connected: ConnectedEvent;
  alphabet: AlphabetEvent;
  action: ActionEvent;
}

/** The actions this plugin mints itself, with their params. */
export type SyntheticActionEvent =
  | { action: 'reactivate'; params: ReactivateParams; correlation_id?: string }
  | { action: 'noop'; params: NoopParams; correlation_id?: string }
  | { action: 'set_badge_mode'; params: SetBadgeModeParams; correlation_id?: string }

  | { action: 'query_windows'; params: QueryWindowsParams; correlation_id?: string }
  | { action: 'move_active_tab_to_window'; params: MoveActiveTabToWindowParams; correlation_id?: string }
  | { action: 'pop_active_tab'; params: PopActiveTabParams; correlation_id?: string }
  | { action: 'resize_window'; params: ResizeWindowParams; correlation_id?: string }
;

export const SYNTHETIC_ACTIONS = [

  'noop',
```
